sectors.trend: Iron ore downside persists, pressuring major miners. Gold exploration active with multiple WA/SA/Greenland discoveries. Rare earths (Dalaroo) gaining strategic relevance.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from soft iron ore. Gold juniors (Platina, Broken Hill, Forrestania, Great Southern) and Dalaroo (rare earths) offer speculative upside. Larvotto's antimony-gold concentrate adds diversification.

sectors.trend: Oil below US$100 and energy prices dumping on US political shift. However, US refiners and majors (Shell, Chevron, Phillips 66, Marathon, Baker Hughes) see structural upside. Diesel/petrol shock rising in Australia.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) face near-term price pressure. Australian consumers hit by fuel costs. US energy names bullish but ASX energy exposure limited.

sectors.trend: Super contributions surge >33% post-budget changes. Bragg housing plan reignites super fight. Higher rates 'new normal' pressures banks' NIM but boosts deposit growth. Housing stress threatens mortgage books.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from rate environment but face housing credit risk. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) see AUM tailwinds. Housing plan could reshape REIT and bank dynamics.

sectors.trend: ASIC warns on price comparison scams. Burger chain cancels breakfast at hundreds of outlets. Fuel shock pressures household budgets. Auction market reality check signals cooling demand.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Consumer discretionary names vulnerable. ASIC enforcement may boost trust in regulated platforms.

sectors.trend: AI rally drives Nasdaq to record. Ciena 2029 roadmap bullish. Nebius price hike signals neocloud strength. AI governance debate (PM urges human control).
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but global AI momentum supports sentiment. CSL.AX biotech/health-tech crossover benefits. Domestic tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) ride global AI tide.

sectors.trend: Sydney housing 'bloodbath', auction market cooling. Bragg housing plan and new digital pension pillar could reshape property investment. Rental market disruption proposed.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICQ.AX) face rental yield pressure. Property developers (SRG.AX, CGP.AX) under stress. Housing policy shift may redirect capital to equities.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open higher on Wall Street strength and AI rally, but interest rate fears and iron ore weakness cap gains. Expect range-bound trading with sector rotation from materials into gold, energy, and financials. Fuel shock and housing stress keep consumer and REIT sectors under pressure.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from super contribution surge, AI adoption, and energy transition support 6–12 month upside. However, Trump trade war, China slowdown, and housing market correction pose material risks. RBA policy path and Bragg housing/super reforms will be key swing factors. Gold and rare earths offer structural diversification.
